description: In-character fallback dialogue lines for NOVA when API timeouts, speech glitches, or network errors occur
generalFallbacks: Static on our internal audio bus, Commander. Could you repeat that order?
Solar particle interference scrambled that transmission. Say again?
My auditory processors caught only part of that sentence. Speak clearly, Commander.
I was running a thermal cycle on panel four and missed that command. Repeat please?
That request sounded garbled through my comms filter. Try rephrasing your order.
Cosmic ray hit a logic buffer. The ship state is untouched, but I need you to repeat that.
I heard background noise, but no valid flight directive. What is your command?
Pardon me, Commander? Even an advanced artificial intelligence occasionally needs you to speak up.
Telemetry hiccup on the bridge bus. Re-issue your instruction whenever you are ready.
I caught the sarcasm, but not the actual command. Mind repeating that?
Audio buffer packet loss. Try saying that again, preferably in plain flight-manual terms.
My subroutines blinked for a millisecond. All systems are nominal, but please repeat your order.
timeoutFallbacks: High-latency lag on the neural bus. Ship state is stable, but please repeat your instruction.
Houston was hogging our primary downlink bandwidth. What were you saying, Commander?
Took me a moment to chew through that calculation. Try repeating your directive.
speechRecognitionFallbacks: Microphone input was faint or muffled. Check your audio settings or type your command.
I detected audio input, but the words were indecipherable. Could you say that again?
If you were speaking to me, you were whispering into the vacuum. Speak into the mic, Commander.
unrecognizedCommandFallbacks: That is not a valid flight procedure in the NASA flight manual. Try checking your mission objective.
I cannot execute that command, Commander. Look at the HUD for valid operational options.
Even with my quantum cores, I have no idea what that means. Check the suggested commands on screen.
